name: How do I keep a bathroom remodel on budget?

mainEntity.name: How do I keep a bathroom remodel on budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best way to protect your budget is to finalize selections early and avoid changing them after work begins. Keep the existing layout if possible, choose materials with a clear price range, and get an itemized estimate before demolition. A realistic contingency fund also helps you handle surprises without cutting quality elsewhere.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lock in your selections early, keep the layout if possible, use itemized bids, and keep a contingency fund for surprises.
